request:
I run a small provisions shop in Madina and I want to keep my price list on the computer instead of in my notebook. I want to add the things I sell with their prices. I want to see everything I sell, and look up the price of one thing. Sometimes I stop selling something, so I want to take it off the list.

The client's answers to your questions:
Q: When a price goes up or down, do you want to change the price of something already on the list?
A: Yes, prices change all the time, especially sugar, rice and oil. I need to change the price of an item.
Q: Do some things have more than one price, like a small and a big size, or one price for a single piece and another for a full box or carton?
A: No preference: you decide.
Q: When you look up a price, do you want to type just part of the name (like 'milo') and see all matching things, or will you type the full exact name?
A: No preference: you decide.

Where the client has no preference or did not answer, choose the simplest option and add nothing they did not ask for (no logins, PINs or extra required fields).
summary:
I've built your price list in one file, `app.py`, and all 24 automatic tests pass. It keeps your items in a file called `price_list.db` in the same folder. Each item has a name and one price in Ghana cedis.

**What you can do**
- **Add an item** (`POST /items`): send a name and a price, for example `{"name": "Rice 5kg bag", "price": 85.50}`.
- **See your whole list** (`GET /items`): shows every item with its price, in alphabetical order.
- **Look up one price** (`GET /items/{name}`): type the full name exactly as it is on the list. Names with a slash, like "Oil 1/2 litre", work too.
- **Change a price** (`PATCH /items/{name}`): send the new price, for example `{"price": 90}`.
- **Take an item off the list** (`DELETE /items/{name}`).

**What gets refused**
- An item with no name, an empty name or a name of only spaces.
- A missing price, or a price that is empty, zero, negative or not a number. This applies when adding an item and when changing a price. A price typed as text, like "10", is also refused; it must be sent as a plain number.
- An item whose name is already on the list. The old price stays as it was.
- Looking up, changing or removing an item that isn't on the list. You get a "not found" message.

**Choices we made for you**
- **Capital letters count:** "Sugar" and "sugar" are treated as two different items. Use the same spelling every time.
- **One price per item:** if you sell a single piece and a full carton, add them as separate items, for example "Milo small tin" and "Milo big tin".
- **Full names only:** looking up "milo" won't find "Milo small tin". If you'd prefer to type part of a name and see every match, we can change that.

plan.summary: This plan puts your shop's price list on the computer in place of your notebook. You can add an item with its price, see the whole list, look up the price of one item, change an item's price when it goes up or down, and take an item off the list when you stop selling it. You left two choices to us, so we picked the simplest option for each. First, every item has one price. If you sell a single piece and a full carton, or a small and a big size, you add them as separate items, for example 'Milo small tin' and 'Milo big tin'. Second, to look up a price you type the item's full name exactly as it is on the list. If you would prefer to type just part of a name, like 'milo', and see every matching item, tell us and we can change this. Prices are kept in Ghana cedis. Nothing in your request was unsafe or outside the backend, so nothing was left out. Some questions you may want to think about: Do you want to keep a record of old prices when a price changes? Should anyone besides you be able to see or change the list? Nothing has been added for these unless you ask.

data.name: Item
fields: Name of the thing you sell, for example 'Rice 5kg bag'. Each name appears only once on the list.
Price in Ghana cedis, for example 85.50

endpoints.does: Adds a new item to your price list with its name and price.
Shows every item on your price list with its price.
Shows the price of one item when you type its full name.
Changes the price of an item that is already on the list.
Takes an item off your price list when you stop selling it.

rules: An item cannot be added without a name.
An item cannot be added without a price.
The price must be a number greater than zero. Empty, zero, negative or non-number prices are refused.
An item cannot be added if an item with the same name is already on the list.
If you look up an item that is not on the list, you are told it was not found.
If you try to change the price of an item that is not on the list, you are told it was not found.
If you try to take off an item that is not on the list, you are told it was not found.
